title: Choice of functions for the bias test

posts.name: Alexandre Nikitenko
posts.text:
Dear experts,
we have as a baseline Chebyshev function for the background descrition in our dimuon excess analysis. We want now to do bias test using a different functions.  Do you have any recepie how we should select these functions. So far, we used criteria delta NLL < 0.5 from Chebyshev (as in F-test). Does it looks reasonable for you or you have different recepie ? If we do not pass bias test (bias <= 20 %) we will go to descrete profiling where we were told we do not need to worry about bad functions, since they will be excluded from profiling.
Thanks, Sasha.
Thanks, Sasha.
